integrity: Analytic derivation of universal inequality, exact equality witnesses, documented primary-literature comparisons; finite checker is supplemental, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Real Hilbert-isomorphic Banach spaces of dimension at least two; no classification of all equality cases. The regular-polygon numerical indices were previously determined by Martín and Merí (2007). Bibliographic priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: Sharp square-root control of the real numerical index by Hilbertian distortion
